label: Supabase
description: Supabase connector: pure-logic components for auth and data. Setup Client creates the client from your project URL + anon key (Noodl.Variables.supabase); Log In, Log Out, Sign Up, Send Magic Link, Send Password Reset, Resend Confirmation, Update/Fetch Current User Auth and Profile Data cover the auth flows, and an Example Request shows a from().select() query. No UI — wire the Do/Success/Failure signals into your own pages. Originally by @gmaison and @RicoTrevisan.
